_readme: Facts checked in October 2026 (open status, hours, prices). Applied after copyedit.json and before overrides.json.

barhole-music.note: Hours from listings; check the gig calendar for 15–17 Oct.

a38-ship.hours: Restaurant daily from 08:00 · Gigs from about 19:00 · Club nights 23:30–04:00
a38-ship.note: Event-driven: check the a38.hu programme for your nights.

akvarium-klub.note: Shows are listed into autumn 2026: check akvariumklub.hu for what is on.

hard-rock-cafe-budapest.address: Váci utca 1 (corner of Deák Ferenc utca), 1052 Budapest

robot-club.hours: Inside Instant-Fogas (daily 18:00–06:00) · The Robot room is busiest Thu–Sat

gozsdu-udvar.hours: The passage is open round the clock; each bar sets its own hours, mostly late

csak-a-jo-sor.hours: Mon–Sat 14:00–22:00 · Sun closed (one listing says it shuts at 19:00)

champs-sports-pub.hours: Daily from about 12:00 until 23:30 · Sat until 02:00

lampas.hours: Daily from about 16:00 (Time Out); older listings say Wed–Sat until 04:00

frici-papa.hours: Mon–Sat about 11:00–22:00 (kitchen may stop earlier) · Sun closed
frici-papa.priceText: Daily menu under about 3,000 HUF (£7). Cash preferred.

hungarian-parliament.hours: Tours daily in time slots, roughly 08:00–16:00, from the Visitor Centre · Restricted on sitting days
hungarian-parliament.priceText: EU/EEA passport (Irish): 7,000 HUF adult. Non-EU passport (British): 14,000 HUF adult. Official 2026 prices; bring the passport you booked with.

fishermans-bastion.hours: Lower terraces free 24/7 · Upper terrace ticketed 09:00–19:00, free outside those hours
fishermans-bastion.priceText: Upper terrace 1,700 HUF adult (850 reduced) · Lower terraces free

matthias-church.priceText: Church 3,400 HUF adult (5,000 with audioguide) · Tower is a separate ticket, about 4,000 HUF

hospital-in-the-rock.priceText: Guided tour only, about €30 (around £26) per adult, charged in HUF. Sources disagree, so check when you book. Pay by card.

house-of-terror.note: It closed in mid-September 2026 for a content review and reopened on 22 Sep.

dohany-synagogue.hours: Closed Sat 17 Oct (Sabbath) · Sun 18 Oct from 10:00 to about 16:00, last ticket an hour before closing
dohany-synagogue.priceText: About 14,500 HUF per adult (Sep 2026 guide); older guides quote less.

st-stephens-basilica.hours: Church Mon–Sat about 09:00–17:45 (Sat can close early for weddings), Sun from 13:00 · Dome terrace daily 09:00–19:00
st-stephens-basilica.priceText: Church 2,600 HUF · Dome terrace and treasury 5,000 HUF · Combined 6,800 HUF

cave-church.hours: Mon–Sat 09:30–19:30 · Sun closed · No visits during Mass

dandar-baths.hours: Daily from about 09:00; closing time varies (around 19:00)
dandar-baths.priceText: Indoor about 3,500 HUF weekdays, 4,000 weekends; with sauna about 4,000–4,500 HUF. 2026 rises reported.
dandar-baths.note: Fully reopened after its renovation. 14+ only.

veli-bej-bath.note: Shut for maintenance in late August; ring +36 1 438 8400 to check it has reopened.

communist-free-walking-tour.address: Szent István tér 1, 1051 Budapest (St Stephen’s Basilica)
communist-free-walking-tour.note: This is the meeting point for Guruwalk’s “Reds in Budapest” tour. Other operators meet elsewhere, so check your booking.

great-market-hall.hours: Mon–Fri 06:00–18:00 · Sat 06:00–15:00 · Sun mostly shut, so go on Saturday

sparty-szechenyi.note: We could not confirm a Sat 17 Oct date yet: check the official booking page before you plan around it.

zugliget-chairlift.hours: Closed for maintenance until Fri 16 Oct; due to reopen Sat 17 Oct, about 10:00–17:00, weather permitting
